units.title: assignments
examples: geostrophic wind from contour spacing on a 500 hPa map; compare with plotted winds
sideways Coriolis deflection of a kicked ball
sketch winds at the surface and at 500 hPa around a low from isobars and thickness; predict the storm's motion
thermal wind across the Gulf Stream: horizontal temperature difference from the current's shear
units.notes: 4 question record(s): OCW-12.003-PS6-Q1, OCW-12.003-PS6-Q3, OCW-12.003-PS6-Q4, OCW-12.003-PS6-Q2

units.title: midterm
examples: daily mean insolation against latitude for an axis normal to the Sun line; surface temperature by latitude from a one-slab model
density and potential temperature of a surface parcel; θ and T after lifting dry to 125 hPa; then with all its vapour condensed
emission temperature of Venus from its distance and albedo; layers of an N-layer greenhouse needed for its surface temperature
temperature rise of the air in a closed room from people's and machines' power over an hour
